headline: Soybean Fund Slips as Wheat Gains Amid Record Brazilian Crop Outlook
summary: The SOYB soybean fund fell 1.26% to US$25.81 as Brazil heads for a record crop and China buys cautiously, while wheat gained 0.36%.
why: Agricultural commodity funds reflect global supply and demand balances, crop forecasts, and trade flows from major exporters like Brazil to buyers like China.

impacts.name: Soybean
impacts.why: The soybean fund fell 1.26% due to expectations of a record Brazilian crop.
